name: db-d1
description: Cloudflare D1 database integration with Drizzle ORM, migration support, and type-safe queries

envVars.name: D1_DATABASE_ID
envVars.description: Cloudflare D1 database ID from the Workers dashboard

ai.whenToUse: Use when the project needs a database for user data, content, or application state. D1 is Cloudflare's serverless SQLite database — ideal for edge-deployed Astro apps on Workers.
ai.whenNotToUse: Don't use for static-only sites, purely client-side apps, or projects that already have a different database integration (turso, postgres). Not suitable for read-heavy workloads exceeding D1 limits.
